messages:
sarah_support: FYI — Acme reported a sharp p95/p99 regression for routes that use function_call + structured output. p95 jumped ~3x, p99 ~4x starting ~09:12 UTC. Customer impact: visible latency spikes and a few timeouts. sending repro + traces.
mike_runtime: can you paste a repro request + request_id? also which model/variant?
sarah_support: repro (redacted keys):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model": "redwood-clarity-1",
  "messages": [...],
  "function_call": "auto",
  "structured_output": {
    "schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string"}}},
    "strict_validation": true
  }
}
```
request_id: r-9f3a2b (sample). latency: 420ms -> 1.2s (p95), p99 900ms -> 2.8s. stack traces from console attached: top op is "schema_validator: validate_sync".
deploybot: alert: high-p95-anomaly detected for /v1/chat/completions (service=runtime, host=rt-12). Correlation: high schema_validation duration.
julia_ml: interesting — we've seen validators cause blocking on large schemas when compiled per-request. do we run a compiled-schema cache at ingress? if not, that's the first suspect.
mike_runtime: checking runtime traces now. looks like the tool-router is doing synchronous validation for each tool call and we don't cache compiled validators for JSON-schema. also see extra copies of payload in the router path (serialize -> validate -> reserialize).
omar_product: is this isolated to Acme or broader? any other customers flagged?
sarah_support: so far only customers using structured_output with strict_validation + function routing. I'll pull a list and DM affected owners.
mike_runtime: short-term mitigation: we can add an opt-out flag so customers can set structured_output.strict_validation=false per-request, and a quick config to bypass validation at the router (fall back to model-side validation). can we push that as a gate? low-risk.
julia_ml: mid-term: implement a compiled-schema LRU cache (precompile ajv-style validators at model load or first compile) and run validation in a worker thread pool to avoid blocking the main request path. also remove unnecessary copies by validating in-place when possible.
mike_runtime: agreed. i'll scope a hotfix: 1) add opt-out header/param, 2) enable compiled-schema cache in router with TTL 10m, 3) instrument metric schema_validation_ms. target: prod rollout in next 2 hours for the opt-out, compiled cache in next deploy.
omar_product: communicate to affected customers with suggested workaround (set strict_validation false) and explain upcoming fix. Sarah, can you take owner for customer comms?
sarah_support: on it. drafting message now. will offer the opt-out and ask if they can toggle and report improvements. also collecting full request_ids.
julia_ml: i'll put together microbench numbers — expected 3-6x speedup with compiled cache and worker validation for the worst-case schemas. will share bench and PR today.
mike_runtime: quick probe result: toggling strict_validation=false for one Acme customer brought p95 back down from ~1.2s to ~450ms in our staging replay. posting replay id: replay-7721.
sarah_support: Acme accepted the temporary opt-out and saw ~55% reduction in p95. they want ETA for permanent fix.
mike_runtime: ETA: opt-out live in 20m. compiled-cache + async validation PR by EOD, roll to canary tomorrow. followups: (1) prometheus metric for schema_validation latency, (2) add tracing span name schema_validate.compile vs schema_validate.exec, (3) rollback path if validation fails post-response.
omar_product: thanks team. we'll include this in next status note to affected enterprise customers. cc: legal if any contract SLA issues.
sarah_support: closing loop here — will update thread after opt-out rollout and post customer confirmation. :white_check_mark:
